observations.behavior: Adds explicit exclusion of deleted rows from victim selection and clarifies reachability and survivor ranking. P1.F1.H5, P1.F1.H7, P1.F1.H8
observations.code_quote: SELECT team_id, id, uuid FROM ranked WHERE rn > 1 AND refs = 0 AND NOT is_deleted
observations.posthog_connection: This command removes duplicate person rows; excluding is_deleted rows prevents deleting rows that are already marked as deleted, preserving tombstone semantics and avoiding dangling references. This could prevent incorrect identity merges and preserve downstream event and cohort integrity.

observations.behavior: Adds live distinct-ID and tombstone-aware counts and a survivor ranking that prefers live distinct IDs. P1.F1.H3, P1.F1.H5

observations.posthog_connection: Adds accounting for live distinct IDs and tombstones, and a blocked-group report. This could help diagnose and report incomplete deduplication and distinguish merge candidates from safe deletions, supporting safer identity cleanup and clearer diagnostics.
